scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:structure && pnpm --dir frontend test:unit && uv run --project backend pytest -c backend/pyproject.toml backend/tests
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir frontend format:check && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend/app backend/tests backend/migrations
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && uv run --project backend ruff check backend/app backend/tests backend/migrations
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && uv run --project backend mypy backend/app
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && uv run --project backend python -m compileall -q backend/app
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:unit && pnpm build && pnpm compose:check
